Subject: Quick 20-min intro — pick a good PST/CEST overlap

Hi Elena —

Thanks for your interest in the Software Engineer, Inference role. I'd love to do a short 20-minute intro to learn a bit about your background and walk through the role. Below are three short windows that should overlap decently between my PST schedule (I’m on the West Coast) and CEST where you noted you are based.

Option A: Tue Oct 13 — 08:30–08:50 PDT (17:30–17:50 CEST)
Option B: Wed Oct 14 — 11:00–11:20 PDT (20:00–20:20 CEST)
Option C: Thu Oct 15 — 07:30–07:50 PDT (16:30–16:50 CEST)

If none of those work, tell me the best 30–60 minute window you have in the evening (CEST) and I’ll convert. I can also send a calendar invite (ICS) for whichever slot you pick — attaching an ICS template in case you want to drop one directly into your calendar.

Quick notes:
- This is a casual screen with Marissa (recruiter) and Jonas (hiring manager) copied — no prep needed beyond a quick run-through of your recent work.
- Please attach a copy of your resume if it's easier than linking to your profile — I attached the resume you uploaded to our application.

Calendly link if you'd prefer to pick: https://calendly.com/irene-choi/20min

Best,
Irene Choi
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
